info.title: IYA STS remote PEP control plane
info.description: What the identity service serves for a remote XACML PEP: registration and heartbeat, the pulls (policies, AuthZEN attribute catalogue and callers, reverse-proxy configuration, managed settings and listeners), a defined listener's certificate, the reverse proxy's five validation doors and the PIP. Paths are under PEP_PDP_URL, which carries the realm's prefix (/realm/<id>). Every operation needs a client certificate the service verifies whose entry holds REMOTE_PEPS (the access-control policy on xacml-pep-api: READ for the pulls, the doors and the PIP; WRITE for register, heartbeat and listener-certificate); a refusal is 403 access_denied (STS-XACML-0007, 0008, 0009, 0010, 0179, 0180, or the revocation's code). xacml.enabled off is 501 (STS-XACML-0001), xacml.remotePeps off 501 (0002), both before the gate. A pull's sync token is base64url SHA-256, sent as ETag in quotes; ?since=<token> equal to it answers 304. Errors are the Error object, with Cache-Control: no-store; no error code is ever in a body, except a route's resolved.code inside the proxy pull. The PEP sends Accept: application/json and User-Agent: sts/<version> (xacml-pep), and follows no redirect.

servers.description: PEP_PDP_URL: the service, with /realm/<id> for a realm.

mutualTLS.description: The PEP's PEP_TLS_CERT, verified by the service, stored on an entry that holds REMOTE_PEPS. The PEP's register name is the certificate's CN (else its DN), folded to [A-Za-z0-9._-] and 128 characters; a name in the request is read only when no certificate was presented.

name.description: PEP_NAME. Read only when no certificate was presented.

notifyUrl.description: Where the service nudges this PEP: https, or empty. notify_url is accepted as an alias.

hostname.description: Sent only when the PEP knows it: a lower-case DNS name of at most 253 characters, not an IP address; anything else is 400 STS-XACML-0261.

syncToken.description: The policy repository's token. Not read by the PEP.

PepSignals.description: The reverse proxy's CAEP and RISC receivers: counts only; the service drops a member it does not name.

rejected.description: Only on notifyUrl, when the one set was not https.

values.description: Every managed setting in force, by key; values are checked against the row and unknown keys dropped.

pool.description: Kept only with all seven members.

name.description: Read only when no certificate was presented.

syncToken.description: The policy set held, empty if none.

HeartbeatRequest.description: Absent keeps what the service holds; null clears signals, settings and listeners; a value replaces it. The counters are set, not added.

syncToken.description: The repository's current token, not the PEP's.

current.description: Whether the PEP holds the current policy set: the one member the PEP reads; false makes it pull.

document.description: The XACML 3.0 Policy or PolicySet, as XML.

root.description: The root policy's name. Not read by the PEP, which uses isRoot.

policies.description: Every enabled policy but those withheld.

withheld.description: Names withheld from PEPs: the access and issuance policies and every policy an application owns.

property.description: A dotted path of at most six segments of [A-Za-z0-9_$@:-]{1,64}.

realm.description: The realm's id; empty for the default realm.

apiObject.description: sts-authzen-api when the realm has the API's resource object.

leftOut.description: Rows left out of the catalogue (STS-AUTHZEN-0060).

fgaApplications.description: Applications enforcing fine-grained authorization, whose evaluations the PEP forwards; each non-empty, at most 256 characters, or the PEP refuses the whole catalogue.

door.description: The realm's authzen.callerAuthentication. The edge admits callers only when it is mtls.

callers.description: Sorted by name; empty unless door is mtls.

roles.description: The roles each action of the model needs, at most 8 each: create, read, update, delete for crud; read, write for read-write.

name.description: An HTTP token, not a reserved header.

RouteResolution.description: What the service resolved for a route. When not usable, why and code (STS-XACML-0217 to 0223, 0228: the one error code this surface sends).

upstream.description: An absolute http(s) URL with no userinfo, query or fragment.

publicBaseUrl.description: An origin or empty; https when any route uses session.

clientSecret.description: The application client's secret, in the clear: the PEP is its relying party.

authorizationEndpoint.description: Not read: the PEP discovers it from issuer.

tokenEndpoint.description: Not read: the PEP discovers it from issuer.

endSessionEndpoint.description: Not read: the PEP discovers it from issuer.

clients.description: By client id: each session route's client.

serviceCookiePrefixes.description: Cookies of the service's the proxy strips upstream; absent or null is the built-in list.

ProxyPull.description: configured false: note alone. configured true: proxy, realm and validation. A cluster member gets its cluster's document.

ManagedSettings.description: Only the keys an administrator set. A notifyUrl that is not https is held and refused by the PEP.

id.description: Not one of the four environment listeners' ids.

SettingsPull.description: configured false: note; configured true: settings. listeners only when at least one is defined; environmentTuning always, unless the stored listeners failed validation (STS-XACML-0252), when neither is sent.

listener.description: A defined https listener of this PEP.

csr.description: PKCS #10, PEM or base64 DER; its key one of the listener's keyAlg values.

name.description: Read only when no certificate was presented; the PEP does not send it.

issued.description: False when the certificate held was answered again.

fullChainPem.description: Leaf to Root, each PEM ending in a newline: the one member the PEP reads.

Introspection.description: active false alone, or active true with the RFC 7662 members that are not null.

BasicValidation.description: valid false alone, or valid true with username, sub and a ticket: opaque, bound to this PEP, good for 120 s, the evidence the identity door takes.

assertion.description: The assertion's XML, base64; at most 262144 bytes decoded.

SamlValidation.description: valid false alone (the reason audited: STS-XACML-0208 to 0213), or valid true with the assertion's subject and its facts.

name.description: Only when it differs from username.

route.description: A non-public route of this PEP's own proxy document.

claims.description: headers mode only: claims the route's headers name.

IdentityRequest.description: Closed: any other member is 400 STS-XACML-0229.

IdentityAnswer.description: By the route's identity.mode. headers: claims (groups and amr are lists; a claim with no value is left out). jwt: accessToken, tokenType and expiresIn. saml: samlResponse, acsUrl and notOnOrAfter.

PipRequest.description: A PIPRequest in urn:sts:xacml:pip:1.0: one XACML 3.0 core Request (urn:oasis:names:tc:xacml:3.0:core:schema:wd-17) whose access-subject category carries subject-id (IncludeInResult true) and, for an application, urn:sts:xacml:subject-kind; then 1 to xacml.pipMaxDesignators (50) AttributeDesignator elements in the core namespace, MustBePresent false. No DOCTYPE or ENTITY.

PipResponse.description: A PIPResponse in urn:sts:xacml:pip:1.0: one XACML core Attributes per category asked (only access-subject is ever resolved), each Attribute (IncludeInResult false) with one or more AttributeValue; an empty bag is an absent Attribute. Then, if any, Unresolved holding a Designator (Category, AttributeId, DataType, MustBePresent) with a Reason for each designator not resolved.

post.description: The PEP registers on every poll until this answers 200 or 201. With xacml.pepRequireCertificate (the default) a certificate is required: a plain socket is 401 STS-XACML-0017, TLS with no certificate 0018.

400.description: The register refused: no usable name (STS-XACML-0019), a bad hostname (0261), no directory (0026), or the directory refused or xacml.maxPeps is reached (0027).

post.summary: Report what this PEP holds and does
post.description: Every PEP_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS: the policy held, the decision counters, the settings in force, the reverse proxy's receivers and the listeners.

400.description: No name (STS-XACML-0020) or a bad hostname (0261).

404.description: Not registered (STS-XACML-0021); also no directory (0026) and the directory refused (0027).

get.description: Every PEP_POLL_INTERVAL_MS, on a nudge, and when a heartbeat says the PEP is not current.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The token held; equal to the current one answers 304.

parameters.name: pep
parameters.description: The register name, whose last-seen time is touched. Not bound to the certificate.

get.summary: Pull the realm's AuthZEN attribute catalogue

500.description: The fine-grained authorization applications could not be read (STS-FGA-0108); answered before since is compared.

get.summary: Pull who may ask the AuthZEN edge PDP

get.description: Pulled only while PEP_PROXY is on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Read only when no certificate was presented; the PEP does not send it.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Sent by the PEP; not read.

get.summary: Pull the managed settings and listeners
get.description: A 404 is a service older than #1760: the PEP puts its environment in force (STS-XPEP-0101).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Read only when no certificate was presented; the PEP does not send it.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Sent by the PEP; not read.

post.summary: Have a defined HTTPS listener's certificate issued

400.description: Not a defined https listener of this PEP (STS-XACML-0253), or a bad CSR or key (0254).

post.description: The oauth2 mechanism, after the PEP's own JWS check. Rate-limited per address and DN by xacml.pipMaxPerWindow (429 STS-XACML-0215, Retry-After) before the gate; any throw is 500 STS-XACML-0216.

post.summary: Validation door: a username and password
post.description: The basic mechanism. The same limiter and failure as introspect; a password the service has locked out is a 429 of its own, {valid: false, retryAfterS} (STS-XACML-0205).

200.description: Valid or not; the reason is audited (STS-XACML-0206).

429.description: Locked out (BasicLockout, STS-XACML-0205), or the limiter (Error, 0215). Retry-After either way.

post.description: The saml2 mechanism, after the PEP's own check. The same limiter and failure as introspect.

post.summary: Validation door: is a sign-on session live
post.description: The session mechanism, every PEP_PROXY_SESSION_RECHECK_MS when no signal says. The same limiter and failure as introspect.

post.summary: Validation door: the identity to deliver upstream
post.description: For a route's identity.mode: the claims for its headers, a service-issued access token, or a SAML Response for the application's ACS. The same limiter and failure as introspect.

400.description: Malformed, or claims the route does not name (STS-XACML-0229).

403.description: The gate; not one of this PEP's non-public routes (STS-XACML-0230); the evidence invalid or not for the application (0231); the ticket unknown, expired or another PEP's (0232); the issuance policy refused (0234).

422.description: The route not usable, no SAML entity ID or no directory entry (STS-XACML-0233); issuance failed (0235).

post.description: Before evaluation the PEP walks the policy for every designator it could be asked about and fetches them all in one request; the answer feeds a synchronous resolver. A subject homed in another cell is relayed there and answered by it. Rate-limited (xacml.pipMaxPerWindow) before the gate. The PEP reads no refusal: any status but 200 is an empty bag for every designator.

400.description: Not a well-formed PIPRequest (STS-XACML-0023), too many designators (0024), a value too long (0025).

501.description: XACML or remote PEPs off, in JSON.
